title: agent-primitives evidence envelope
description: One piece of evidence about one check: what was executed, against which checkout, and how it ended. Written by `agent-primitives verify --evidence`, one envelope per JSON line.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema the envelope follows.

phase.description: Which moment the evidence was gathered at, as the caller named it.

producer.description: Who produced the run, as the caller stated it. `ci` additionally needs `ci_run`.

ci_run.description: A CI run id or URL. Required for producer `ci`, not allowed for any other producer. The schema cannot check it against a CI; a consumer that trusts `ci` does.

time.description: When the check finished, ISO 8601 in UTC.

commit.description: HEAD of the git work tree the check ran in, read by code.

dirty.description: Whether that work tree had a tracked change or an untracked, non-ignored file when the check started, read by code.

commands_digest.description: SHA-256 (lower-case hex) over the canonical JSON of the run's argv lists, selector placeholders unsubstituted.

selector.description: The selector substituted into the command, or null.

command.description: The argv that was executed, program first. Empty only when the check was skipped.

exit.description: The exit code, or null when the command has none (skipped, timed out, killed, never started).

result.description: pass, fail, skip (not run, proves nothing) or error (could not be run to a verdict).
